title: HECinBOX: an automated agent-based flood warning framework using 2D unsteady HEC-RAS simulation

creators.name: Kahrizi, Ehsan
creators.affiliation: Department of Civil, Construction and Environmental Engineering, University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA

creators.name: Moftakhari, Hamed
creators.affiliation: Department of Civil, Construction and Environmental Engineering, University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA

description:
HECinBOX is an open-source, containerized framework that turns an existing, calibrated two-dimensional unsteady HEC-RAS model into a continuously operating flood early-warning system.

It retrieves discharge and stage data from USGS and NOAA CO-OPS, ingests NWM and STOFS forecasts and AORC and HRRR gridded precipitation, writes the data into the model through the DSS-7 pathway the solver actually reads, executes the headless HEC-RAS Linux compute engine without a Windows desktop, then extracts, maps and validates the results and issues threshold-based email alerts through a stateful warning agent. A scheduling daemon supports unattended operation and a read-only dashboard supports dissemination.

This record archives the source code. The HEC-RAS Linux compute engine is distributed by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers under its own terms and is not redistributed here; the published Docker image bundles it.
